title: backfill BFS issues O(parents) sequential has_entry DB queries per entry
description: backfill.rs BFS inner loop calls storage.has_entry() once per parent CID for every entry fetched. For a chain of depth D with branching factor B this is O(D*B) sequential DB round-trips. Replace with a batch EXISTS or IN-clause query: SELECT id FROM log_entries WHERE id IN (?) for all parent IDs at once, then diff against the known set.
